label: MRtrix3 mrstats
description:
Compute images statistics

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: ignorezero
parameters.description: ignore zero values during statistics calculation
parameters.usage: ignore zero values during statistics calculation Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: allvolumes
parameters.description: generate statistics across all image volumes, rather than one set of statistics per image volume
parameters.usage: generate statistics across all image volumes, rather than one set of statistics per image volume Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: image
input_slots.description: the input image from which statistics will be computed.

input_slots.label: mask
input_slots.description: only perform computation within the specified binary mask image.

output_slots.label: report
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Compute images statistics
